title: Guided Engineering Requirement Schema
description: Atomic unit inside a spec. Functional or non-functional.

requirementId.description: Stable identifier. Lowercase letters, digits, dots, underscores, hyphens.

priority.description: MoSCoW priority. 'wont' = explicitly out of scope.

description.description: What the requirement states, in plain language.

rationale.description: Why this requirement exists. Helps prevent silent removal later.

source.description: Where the requirement comes from (stakeholder, PRD section, regulation, incident...).

acceptanceCriteriaIds.description: IDs of acceptance criteria that verify this requirement.
